keyVerseDR: "Go ye therefore into the highways; and as many as you shall find, call to the marriage." (Mt 22:9)

level1.title: Come to the Party!
level1.story: A king gave a wedding feast for his son. Many people did not come. So he invited everyone from the streets to the party!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How do you say yes to God?
level1.prayer: Jesus, I say yes to Your invitation. Amen.

activity.title: The great feast
activity.intro: Mass is the feast God invites us to! Mark each word you hear.

level2.title: The Wedding Feast
level2.story: Jesus said the kingdom of heaven is like a king who gave a wedding feast for his son. He sent servants to call the invited guests, but they would not come; some went to their farms or businesses. The king said, "Go out to the roads and invite everyone you find." The hall was filled with guests, good and bad alike. But one man came without a wedding garment, for many are called, but few are chosen.
level2.keyLine: As many as you shall find, call to the marriage.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How can you prepare for Mass?
level2.prayer: Lord, make me ready for Your feast. Amen.

activity.title: Ready for the feast
activity.intro: Mass is a feast! Get ready to come on time.
items: Lay out my Sunday clothes the night before

art.mainBrief: King's wedding feast, servants inviting people from the road
